title: Query probability of the second coordinate
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^3\to\mathbb R$ be given by $f(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2$, where $t=2+\frac{\sqrt{33}}{3}$. Consider the decision tree that first queries coordinate $0$; if $x_0=-1$, it queries coordinate $1$ and, unless $x_1=-1$, then queries coordinate $2$; if $x_0=1$, it queries coordinate $2$ and, unless $x_2=-1$, then queries coordinate $1$. This tree computes $f$; under a uniform product input on the sign cube, it queries coordinate $1$ with probability $3/4$.
